Ayaan wanted (a) ___ make a birthday card. He folded (b) ___ piece of paper and drew flowers (c) ___ the front. Inside, he wrote (d) ___ short message for his sister. He checked the spelling (e) ___ colouring the picture. His friend suggested adding (f) ___ blue around the flowers. Ayaan liked the idea (g) ___ thanked him. He put the card (h) ___ an envelope.
